misprints.note: Ungdomsförsök: 'ὅ τις νέος ὢν ἐποίησειν' as printed.
Ungefärlig: 'l. ὡς l. μέ-λιστα διακόσιοι'; the print has ε.
The breathing on ἡβῶν looks rough in the print, though ἡβάω takes a smooth breathing. Kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The breathing is small. It looks rough, like the ἡ article nearby, but smooth (ἡβῶν) is also possible.
The article is printed with breathing and accent; I read rough + acute (οἵ) and kept the OCR.
Italic Latin 'vv.' (verben) looks like υυ in this face. Kept as the Swedish abbreviation vv.
